info.name: Open Charge Map Comment Poi API

params.name: output
params.description: Optional output format `json`,`geojson`,`xml`,`csv`, JSON is the default and recommended as the highest fidelity.

params.name: client
params.description: String to identify your client application. Optional but recommended to distinguish your client from other bots/crawlers

params.name: maxresults
params.description: Limit on max number of results returned

params.name: countrycode
params.description: 2-character ISO Country code to filter to one specific country

params.name: countryid
params.description: Exact match on a given numeric country id (comma separated list)

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude for distance calculation and filtering

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude for distance calculation and filtering

params.name: distance
params.description: Optionally filter results by a max distance from the given latitude/longitude

params.name: distanceunit
params.description: `miles` or `km` distance unit

params.name: operatorid
params.description: Exact match on a given EVSE operator id (comma separated list)

params.name: connectiontypeid
params.description: Exact match on a given connection type id (comma separated list)

params.name: levelid
params.description: Exact match on a given charging level (1-3) id (comma separated list)

params.name: usagetypeid
params.description: Exact match on a given usage type id (comma separated list)

params.name: statustypeid
params.description: Exact match on a given status type id (comma separated list)

params.name: dataproviderid
params.description: Exact match on a given data provider id id (comma separated list).

params.name: opendata
params.description: Use opendata=true for only OCM provided ("Open") data.

params.name: includecomments
params.description: If true, user comments and media items will be include in result set

params.name: verbose
params.description: Set to false to get a smaller result set with null items removed.

params.name: compact
params.description: Set to true to remove reference data objects from output (just returns IDs for common reference data such as DataProvider etc).

params.name: camelcase
params.description: Set to true to get a property names in camelCase format.

params.name: chargepointid
params.description: Exact match on a given OCM POI ID (comma separated list)

params.name: boundingbox
params.description: Filter results to a given bounding box. specify top left and bottom right box corners as: (lat,lng),(lat2,lng2)

params.name: polygon
params.description: Filter results within a given Polygon. Specify an encoded polyline for the polygon shape. Polygon will be automatically closed from the last point to the first point.

params.name: polyline
params.description: Filter results along an encoded polyline, use with distance param to increase search distance along line. Polyline is expanded into a polygon to cover the search distance.

params.name: sortby
params.description: Default sort order is based on spatial index but you can optionally sort by  `modified_asc` for results in order of modification (oldest to newest), or ` id_asc` for results in order of ID

params.name: modifiedsince
params.description: Filter to results modified after the given date

params.name: greaterthanid
params.description: Filter to items with ID greater than given value

items.docs: Used to fetch a list of POIs (sites) within a geographic boundary or near a specific latitude/longitude. This is the primary method for most applications and services to consume data from Open Charge Map.
